page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c2.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.c2 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs paired with 16.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.c2.medium ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention from neighboring tenants. The 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory makes this instance highly compute-dense. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring substantial processing power but minimal memory overhead, as users do not pay for excess RAM capacity.

The lack of local storage requires the attachment of external network storage for persistent data. Consequently, this instance is best suited for compute-intensive workloads such as batch processing, distributed analytics nodes, and CPU-bound microservices. It is not recommended for memory-intensive databases or applications requiring high-speed local disk I/O.
